[We] must leave immediately.|Tenel Ka|We were all supposed to be in the dining hall!|Jaina|So that bomb&mdash;|Ta'a Chume|&mdash;was meant for the princess and me.|attr=Ta'a Chume, Tenel Ka, and Jaina after the explosion of the bomb|src=<ref name="Lightsabers" />}}
In [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the dining hall of [[Fountain Palace]], the personal residence of the [[Hapan]] [[Queen Mother]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]], was '''bombed'''. The [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] was meant to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Ta'a Chume]], the [[Matriarch/Legends|matriarch]] of Hapes, and her granddaughter [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]], the Hapan [[Prince/Legends|princess]]. However, because they had unexpectedly decided to eat in Tenel Ka's private room with her friends and fellow [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainees]] [[Lowbacca]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], no one was hurt by the explosion of the bomb.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

As a result of the bomb, the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were sent to the private [[Reef Fortress Island|island]] stronghold of the [[Hapan Royal House|Royal Family of Hapes]], [[Reef Fortress]], where they were watched over by [[Yfra]], who was Ta'a Chume's personal [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]], and some [[Hapan Royal Guard|Hapan Honor Guards]]. Ta'a Chume traveled back and forth between Reef Fortress and Fountain Palace as she personally attended the investigation of the bombing. Later, [[Unidentified bomb conspirator|one]] of the bomb conspirators was caught. However, the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] was [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] before she could be interrogated.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bombing of Fountain Palace first appeared in ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]'', which was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]] and published in [[1996]].<ref name="Lightsabers" />
